definition: Stations, sensors or networks observing climate, weather, hydrology or explicitly climate-relevant environmental conditions. Forecasting and data platforms qualify separately when explicit.
Systems or models producing weather, climate or natural-hazard forecasts or projections. Warning issuance is ews and requires separate evidence.
Platforms or databases maintaining, integrating or processing climate, hazard, exposure or vulnerability information. A one-off analytical map alone is cra.
Health surveillance explicitly incorporating climate or weather information to monitor or predict climate-sensitive illness. Generic disease surveillance is insufficient.
User-facing products or services that package climate information without a specific adaptation recommendation or hazard warning. Those functions qualify separately when explicit.
